diagnosis.rootCause: The stable Tauri application identifier reused the existing IndexedDB settings and therefore selected the previously configured external library instead of the bundled demo seed. The selected library has no active or historical V20 visual source accepted by the backend.
diagnosis.inferenceBoundary: The exact external library path was not read from browser storage. The installed seed was validated read-only, and the backend can emit this stable code only after opening the configured library and finding no accepted visual source.

change.behavior: AGENT_IMMERSIVE_VISUAL_SOURCE_MISSING automatically selects the existing static background and emits a bounded informational notice. Payload deadlines, mount timeouts, invalid active snapshots, revision mismatches, database errors and all other failures remain terminal.

startup.observation: The installed application opened the main Sidera UI while the selected external library reported no V20 snapshot. The existing static background was used and AGENT_IMMERSIVE_VISUAL_SOURCE_MISSING did not block startup.

institutionSilentRestore.trigger: first entry into literature-workbench institution resources
institutionSilentRestore.interpretation: Silent restoration and capability truth are working, but the current official database and personal-library sessions are no longer valid. Unified discovery availability does not prove those two authenticated capabilities.

structuredMultiPageSearch.reason: The installed-build short acceptance did not repeat official authentication or blind login attempts. Earlier R6 native multi-page evidence remains valid for the feature, but is not relabeled as installed-build acceptance.

computerControlLaunchCaveat.observation: The computer-control app registry once resolved the generic Sidera application identity to an older beta.1 installation under D:\wenjian\Desktop\Research Hotspots Desktop. That window was closed and was excluded from acceptance.
computerControlLaunchCaveat.requiredLaunchMethod: Use the exact installed executable path D:\wenjian\Desktop\Sidera\research-hotspots-desktop.exe.

privacy: No Cookie, credential, ticket, account field, raw institutional page, browser-storage value or user paper body was read, copied, logged or persisted.
deliveryConclusion: The corrected beta.3 Full Demo is independently installable, starts without a V20 visual source and exits normally. Cross-restart institutional sign-in is not guaranteed; database and personal-library access currently require official manual authentication.
